FROM node:22-bookworm

# Build tools needed by the 'canvas' npm package (node-gyp / Cairo bindings)
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
      build-essential \
      python3 \
      libcairo2-dev \
      libpango1.0-dev \
      libjpeg-dev \
      libgif-dev \
      librsvg2-dev \
      pkg-config \
      git \
 && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

WORKDIR /app

# Clone, pin to the base commit, then STRIP .git so the agent cannot inspect
# the fix PR or future history (anti-cheat). Re-init a single base commit with
# an immutable tag so the verifier can reset test files; git apply still works.
RUN git clone https://github.com/vega/vega /app \
 && git -C /app checkout 15c5b1f0492e928d5b799de17c187323fed652de \
 && rm -rf /app/.git \
 && git -C /app init -q \
 && git -C /app -c user.email=h@l -c user.name=h add -A \
 && git -C /app -c user.email=h@l -c user.name=h commit -q -m base \
 && git -C /app tag harbor_base

# Pre-install all workspace dependencies (monorepo root install) so verify
# time does not wait on the network. This also compiles the canvas native addon.
RUN DISABLE_POSTINSTALL_SCRIPT=1 npm ci --prefer-offline || DISABLE_POSTINSTALL_SCRIPT=1 npm install

# Build all workspace packages so test-time ESM imports resolve correctly.
RUN npm run build --workspaces --if-present 2>&1 | tail -10 || true

# Visual evidence, readable by the agent at /app/.harbor_assets/.
# tests/ and solution/ are intentionally NOT copied — the harness supplies them.
RUN mkdir -p /logs /app/.harbor_assets
COPY assets/ /app/.harbor_assets/

CMD ["bash"]

mkdir -p /logs/verifier
STDOUT_LOG=/logs/verifier/test-stdout.txt
STDERR_LOG=/logs/verifier/test-stderr.txt
TAP_LOG=/logs/verifier/tap-output.txt
: > "$STDOUT_LOG"; : > "$STDERR_LOG"; : > "$TAP_LOG"

ensure_reward() { [ -f /logs/verifier/reward.txt ] || echo 0 > /logs/verifier/reward.txt; }
trap ensure_reward EXIT

cd /app || { echo "no /app" | tee -a "$STDERR_LOG"; exit 1; }

# Robustness: restore any test paths the agent may have edited to their
# pristine base state BEFORE applying test.patch, so agent edits to tests
# cannot change scoring. (Source fix preserved.)

done

echo "== applying test.patch ==" | tee -a "$STDOUT_LOG"
git apply --binary /tests/test.patch 2>>"$STDERR_LOG" \
  || git apply /tests/test.patch 2>>"$STDERR_LOG" \
  || patch -p1 -i /tests/test.patch 2>>"$STDERR_LOG" \
  || { echo "ERROR: could not apply test.patch" | tee -a "$STDERR_LOG"; exit 1; }

echo "== building vega-scale (pretest/rollup --config-test) ==" | tee -a "$STDOUT_LOG"
cd /app/packages/vega-scale \
  && npm run pretest 2>>"$STDERR_LOG" \
  || { echo "ERROR: pretest build failed" | tee -a "$STDERR_LOG"; exit 1; }

echo "== running f2p + p2p tests via tape ==" | tee -a "$STDOUT_LOG"

/app/node_modules/.bin/tape 'test/**/*-test.js' > "$TAP_LOG" 2>>"$STDERR_LOG" \
  || echo "(tape exited non-zero; parsing report)" | tee -a "$STDOUT_LOG"

cat "$TAP_LOG" >> "$STDOUT_LOG"

python3 /tests/verifier.py 2>>"$STDERR_LOG" | tee -a "$STDOUT_LOG"
echo "reward=$(cat /logs/verifier/reward.txt 2>/dev/null)" | tee -a "$STDOUT_LOG"

import json
import re
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

# Hunks for these paths never reach the judge: it must grade the fix, not the harness the

EXCLUDE_RE = re.compile(
    r"(\.test\.[jt]sx?$|\.spec\.[jt]sx?$|(^|/)tests?/|(^|/)__tests__/|"
    r"(^|/)__snapshots__/|(^|/)node_modules/|(^|/)\.git/)"
)
BASE_REFS = ("harbor_base", "HEAD")

JUDGE_SYSTEM = (
    "You are a strict senior engineer grading the APPROACH of a code change -- not whether "
    "its tests pass. Score each rubric criterion STRICTLY BINARY: 1 = fully satisfied, "
    "0 = not satisfied. There is NO partial credit: if a criterion is only partially met, "
    "ambiguous, or has no clear evidence, score 0. Be strict; when unsure, score 0."

    return Path(os.environ.get("PB_JUDGE_DIR") or DEFAULT_JUDGE_DIR)


def candidate_diff(repo: str, budget: int = 120_000) -> str:
    for ref in BASE_REFS:
        try:

def filter_diff(diff: str, budget: int) -> str:
    kept, cur, keep = [], [], True

            parts = line.split()

            keep = not EXCLUDE_RE.search(path)
            cur = [line]

            cur.append(line)

    blob = "".join(kept)
    return blob[:budget] + "\n[... truncated ...]\n" if len(blob) > budget else blob

    """Lay down everything a judge sub-agent needs, with no further context."""
    jdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    payload = [{"id": c["id"], "criterion": c["criterion"]} for c in criteria]
    (jdir / "criteria_payload.json").write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2))

0 = not satisfied, ambiguous, or no clear evidence. Be strict; when unsure, score 0.

so do not withhold a 1 over style preferences the criterion does not actually state.

Write ONLY this JSON to `{verdict}`:

    {{"scores": {{"<criterion id>": {{"score": 0|1}}, ...}}}}

All {len(criteria)} ids must appear: {ids}. Verify the file parses before you finish.

def read_verdict(criteria, jdir: Path):
    """Return ("pass"|"fail", failed_ids) or None when no usable verdict exists."""
    vp = Path(os.environ.get("PB_JUDGE_VERDICT") or (jdir / "verdict.json"))
    if not vp.is_file():
        return None
    try:
        obj = json.loads(vp.read_text())
    except Exception as exc:
        sys.stderr.write("[judge] verdict unreadable (%s)\n" % exc)
        return None
    scores = obj.get("scores", obj)
    if not isinstance(scores, dict):
        sys.stderr.write("[judge] verdict has no scores map\n")
        return None
    failed, graded = [], 0
    for c in criteria:
        raw = scores.get(c["id"])
        if raw is None:
            failed.append(c["id"])            # not graded == not demonstrated == fail

        try:

        except (TypeError, ValueError, AttributeError):

            continue

        if v < 1.0:                            # strictly binary: only a full 1 passes

        return None
    return ("fail" if failed else "pass"), failed

    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--rubrics", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--repo", default="/app")
    ap.add_argument("--judge-dir", default=None)
    a = ap.parse_args()

    jdir = Path(a.judge_dir) if a.judge_dir else judge_dir()
    try:
        doc = json.load(open(a.rubrics))
    except Exception as exc:
        sys.stderr.write("[judge] cannot read %s: %s\n" % (a.rubrics, exc))
        return 0
    criteria = [c for c in (doc.get("criteria") or []) if c.get("id") and c.get("criterion")]

        return 0

    res = read_verdict(criteria, jdir)
    if res is not None:
        verdict, failed = res
        try:
            jdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            json.dump({"rubric": verdict, "failed": failed,

                      open(jdir / "summary.json", "w"), indent=2)

                         % (verdict, (" failed=%s" % ", ".join(failed)) if failed else ""))
        print(verdict)
        return 0

    # Phase 1: no verdict yet -> lay down the request and stay silent.
    diff = candidate_diff(a.repo)
    if not diff.strip():
        sys.stderr.write("[judge] empty candidate diff; nothing to grade\n")
        return 0
    write_request(criteria, diff, jdir)
    sys.stderr.write(

        "(criteria_payload.json, source.txt, PROMPT.md). Have the judge sub-agent produce "
        "verdict.json, then rescore. Scoring on tests alone until then.\n"
        % (jdir / "verdict.json", jdir))
    return 0
